title: ItemRush
description: ItemRush is a Minecraft minigame plugin where players race to find random items before time runs out, featuring progression, rewards, scoreboards, and multiplayer competition.
body:
# ItemRush

ItemRush is a fast-paced Minecraft minigame plugin where players compete to obtain randomly selected items before the timer ends. Players can craft, smelt, collect, or find the target item to win rounds and earn rewards.

The plugin features progressive difficulty levels, automatic round management, live scoreboards, boss bars, sounds, fireworks, rewards, and configurable gameplay settings.

Designed for multiplayer survival servers, events, and competitive minigame networks.

---

## Features

* Random item objectives
* Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties
* Automatic round progression
* Boss bars and action bars
* Real-time scoreboards
* Reward and streak system
* Fireworks and sound effects
* Multiplayer support
* Fully configurable gameplay

---

## Commands

### Player & Admin Commands

| Command                      | Description                     |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `/itemrush start`            | Starts the game                 |
| `/itemrush stop`             | Stops the current game          |
| `/itemrush reload`           | Reloads the configuration       |
| `/itemrush setlobby`         | Sets the lobby location         |
| `/itemrush resetprogression` | Resets progression back to Easy |

---

## Permissions

| Permission       | Description                    |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `itemrush.play`  | Allows players to participate  |
| `itemrush.admin` | Allows administrative commands |


## Configuration

The plugin automatically generates:

```text
plugins/ItemRush/config.yml
```

You can customize:

* Round timers
* Rewards
* Difficulty progression
* Sounds
* Fireworks
* Item pools
* Minimum players
